comments.body: `promiseAll` is called at packages/medusa/src/subscribers/order.js:37 but the file has no import for it. The file's only import-like code is the class definition at lines 1-62, and the diff adds the `promiseAll` call (replacing `Promise.all`) without adding `import { promiseAll } from "@medusajs/utils"`. Every other changed .js file in this PR (shopify.js, contentful.js, brightpearl.js, webshipper-fulfillment.js) does add the import. Because this is plain JS, tsc does not catch it. When an `order.placed` event fires, `handleOrderPlaced` (lines 32-45) runs `retrieveWithTotals` and then throws `ReferenceError: promiseAll is not defined` at line 37, whether or not the order has discounts. As a result, `discountService_.update` is never called and discount `usage_count` is never incremented. The separate `updateDraftOrder` subscriber on the same event is unaffected.
